app.providerNotice: Transparency Notice on Weather Provider Variations:
app.providerExplanation: Weather readings may differ slightly from other mobile applications because providers use different local observation stations, numerical weather models, horizontal grid resolutions, and update intervals. AgriSense directly consumes published data from Open-Meteo & WMO without modification or artificial generation.

forecast.transparencyNote: Published Numerical Forecast Source: Forecast readings are generated by numerical meteorological prediction models (ECMWF IFS, DWD ICON, and NOAA GFS) at 0.1° (~9 km) spatial grid resolution as supplied directly by Open-Meteo. No artificial intelligence or simulated values are fabricated.

history.title: Historical Agrometeorological Records
history.subtitle: Published meteorological history from physical station readings and calibrated reanalysis models
history.dailyTempSubtitle: Published temperature boundaries for the selected historical window
history.dailyPrecipSubtitle: Measured daily rain accumulation in millimeters
history.methodologyStation: 1. Station Observations (Last 1–14 Days): Sourced from land surface stations managed by national meteorological services (WMO Global Observing System). Data points represent calibrated physical thermometer, rain gauge, and anemometer readings.
history.methodologyReanalysis: 2. Reanalysis Estimates (ECMWF ERA5-Land Archive): Reanalysis blends historical surface station observations with satellite scatterometry and numerical physical conservation laws to fill spatial and temporal gaps on an equidistant 9 km grid.

advisor.title: Farm Weather Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Agro-meteorological decision engine analyzing precipitation forecasts, FAO-56 evapotranspiration (ET₀), canopy humidity, and wind dynamics to optimize daily field operations.
advisor.nextPhaseEsp32: Next Phase: ESP32 IoT Soil Moisture Probes
advisor.esp32Desc: This weather advisor forms Module 1 of AgriSense. Soon, readings from physical ESP32 soil moisture, soil temperature, and NPK capacitive probes will fuse with this weather data for autonomous precision irrigation.
advisor.generalNotice: General Agronomic Recommendation Notice: These advisories are calculated using atmospheric models, WMO guidelines, and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration formulas. Always inspect physical soil conditions and verify with local agronomists or physical in-situ sensor probes before initiating heavy irrigation or spraying applications.

plantHealth.spotlightTitle: AI Plant Health & Leaf Disease Scanner
plantHealth.spotlightDesc: Use your camera or upload leaf photographs to detect early fungal blights, rusts, and nutrient deficiencies. Results are automatically cross-referenced with your farm's live temperature and humidity.
plantHealth.heading: Plant Health & Leaf Disease Identification
plantHealth.description: Scan crops using your mobile rear camera or upload close-up leaf photographs to identify symptoms of fungal blights, rusts, bacterial spots, and nutrient deficiencies. Real-time atmospheric microclimates from your farm are synthesized to evaluate infection transmission risk.
plantHealth.scanCameraDesc: Uses your phone or tablet camera to capture an in-situ leaf specimen with live viewfinder guides and optical focus reticles.
plantHealth.uploadPhotoDesc: Select a photograph from your mobile gallery or computer files. Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP images up to 10MB.
plantHealth.dragDrop: Drag & drop from your computer, or tap to choose from your photo gallery (JPG, PNG, WebP up to 10MB)
plantHealth.quickTestSamples: Quick Test: Pre-verified Agricultural Leaf Samples
plantHealth.clickSpecimen: Click any specimen to load immediately
plantHealth.check1: Foliage in clear focus without motion blur
plantHealth.check2: Visible leaf venation and boundary margins detected
plantHealth.guidelinesTitle: Photography Guidelines for Accurate Diagnostic Recognition
plantHealth.guide1Desc: Photograph under bright diffused morning or afternoon sunlight. Avoid harsh shadows or strong flash reflections.
plantHealth.guide2Desc: Hold camera 15-25cm away, ensuring the target leaf blade fills at least 60% of the frame in sharp focus.
plantHealth.guide3Desc: Place a hand or plain surface behind the leaf to prevent background soil or weeds from interfering with recognition.
plantHealth.holdPhone: Hold phone steady 15-25cm above affected leaf blade
plantHealth.daylightHint: Natural daylight provides highest classification accuracy
plantHealth.requestingPermDesc: Please select 'Allow' when prompted by your browser to view the live optical feed.
plantHealth.startingCameraDesc: Synchronizing sensor resolution and optical parameters...
plantHealth.cameraGenericError: Unable to access device camera. Please check camera settings or try uploading a photo.
plantHealth.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera permission was blocked. Please tap the lock/camera icon in your browser address bar and grant camera access for this site.
plantHealth.cameraNotFound: No camera hardware detected on this device. Please connect a camera or choose the image upload option.
plantHealth.cameraInUse: Camera is currently locked or in use by another application or browser tab. Please close conflicting apps and retry.
plantHealth.cameraOverconstrained: The requested camera resolution or lens is unavailable. Switching to default camera mode.
plantHealth.cameraFailed: Failed to initialize camera video feed.
plantHealth.insecureContext: Camera access requires a secure connection (HTTPS) or localhost. Please access AgriSense via HTTPS or use the file upload option.
plantHealth.unsupportedBrowser: Camera access is not supported by your current browser. Please update your browser or upload a leaf photograph directly.
plantHealth.expertAdvisory: When to Seek Expert Agronomic Assessment:
plantHealth.threeTier1: 1. Image Model Prediction: Identifies visual foliar symptoms from the submitted photograph.
plantHealth.threeTier2: 2. Weather-Related Risk Assessment: Evaluates whether atmospheric moisture and temperatures accelerate disease development.
plantHealth.threeTier3: 3. General Recommendations: Agronomic best practices. Weather conditions alone never constitute proof of plant infection.

settings.connectedProvider: Connected: Open-Meteo & WMO World Weather Watch
settings.autoRefreshDesc: Automatic refresh runs every 15 minutes to synchronize latest numerical weather model runs (ECMWF, DWD ICON, and NOAA GFS). All calculations use genuine published meteorological data.
settings.attributionDesc: AgriSense integrates Open-Meteo's open-source atmospheric API, WMO (World Meteorological Organization) weather codes, and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith agrometeorological algorithms. Data is refreshed every 15 minutes.
